name: postflight-monorepo
description: Open-source pre-flight compiler, linter, safe-zone X-ray, and MCP governance studio for social media.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@postflight/core && npm run build --workspace=@postflight/cli && npm run build --workspace=@postflight/mcp && npm run build --workspace=@postflight/studio
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@postflight/core && npm run build --workspace=@postflight/cli && npm run build --workspace=@postflight/mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@postflight/core && npm run typecheck --workspace=@postflight/cli && npm run typecheck --workspace=@postflight/mcp && npm run typecheck --workspace=@postflight/studio
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && node --test packages/core/test/*.test.mjs packages/cli/test/*.test.mjs packages/mcp/test/*.test.mjs

author: prateeekranga (https://github.com/prateeekranga)
